page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top, with the page number 118 at left. Below the head, a table of Greek verb forms in three columns, with a label at the left of each block. Line "Perfe-" at bottom right, a catchword.
page.notes: Greek forms are copied from the scan; the medial sigma glyphs and some accents in the Plusquamperfectum and Infinitum rows are hard to read at this resolution and may differ slightly. The label "Futurum ϛ" is set in italic and its letter is doubtful. The first line of the Plusquamperfectum middle column, "ἐσόλειςον", is uncertain. The final catchword is read as "Perfe-" from the right foot.
